pages.text: Tungsten ore is in diorite in the Overworld. Smelt it to get tungsten ingots. In the End, tungsten ore generates in every biome.$(br2)Tungsten makes machine frames, the entropy cell and the stabilizer.
The observatory is a tower in the Overworld. Its chest holds tungsten ingots, End essence, ender pearls, a voidbloom seed and, rarely, dragonite tea. An ender eye is in its item frame.
